_comment: Loud, documented staleness waivers for the provenance gate (evals/provenance.py). Every entry needs a non-empty reason; remove an entry the moment the artifact is regenerated. Current entries: the 2026-08-10 hta.org domain move and the seven agencies added on 2026-08-12/13/14 (Elk Grove e-tran, Santa Cruz METRO, SolTrans, Fresno Area Express, County Connection, San Joaquin RTD, AC Transit), all pending the same next promoted eval run. Also waived: the 2026-08-13 system-prompt v10 -> v11 change (scope rule widened from five named agencies to all nine) and the v11 -> v12 -> v13 -> v14 changes (County Connection named as the tenth, San Joaquin RTD as the eleventh, AC Transit as the twelfth), pending the same next promoted eval run.

acknowledged.reason: Six causes, all pending the same regeneration. (1) 2026-08-10: hta-fares source domain moved (humboldttransit.org now 404s; site relocated to hta.org). The refetch rebound corpus_version 0938fff0539a to 35ec70d6359d; the refresh report confirmed no policy-text change, only the source URL and fetch metadata. (2) 2026-08-12: Elk Grove Transit Services (e-tran) added as the sixth agency (etran-fares, etran-senior-pass). (3) 2026-08-12: Santa Cruz METRO (SCMTD) added as the seventh agency (scmtd-fares-passes, scmtd-accessibility, scmtd-tap2cruz); merging (2) and (3) rebound corpus_version to feb21f02c510. (4) 2026-08-12: SolTrans (Solano County Transit) added as the eighth agency, four documents (soltrans-fare-table, soltrans-clipper-card, soltrans-ways-to-pay, soltrans-paperless-fares), rebinding corpus_version to 5e6a24ef0702 (20 documents, 140 chunks). (5) 2026-08-13: Fresno Area Express (FAX) added as the ninth agency, three documents (fax-fares plus the corpus's first two PDFs, the reduced-fare program instructions in English and Spanish), rebinding corpus_version once more to 95794539d1d0 (23 documents, 152 chunks). Unlike (1), causes (2) through (8) are all new policy text: the committed scores were computed against a corpus containing none of the four agencies. They remain valid for the cases they cover and say nothing at all about the new E-tran, SCMTD, SolTrans, FAX, CCCTA, SJRTD, or actransit-* cases, none of which has ever been scored live. (6) 2026-08-14: County Connection (CCCTA) added as the tenth agency, five documents (cccta-fare-types-prices, cccta-clipper-card, cccta-transfers, cccta-rtc-discount-card, cccta-link-fares), rebinding corpus_version once more to 60033300dc49 (28 documents, 177 chunks). Like (2) through (5) it is new policy text: the committed scores were computed against a corpus without CCCTA and say nothing about the new CCCTA cases, none of which has ever been scored live. (7) 2026-08-14: San Joaquin RTD (SJRTD) added as the eleventh agency, two documents (sjrtd-fares, sjrtd-dfc), rebinding corpus_version once more to d113659adda8 (30 documents, 188 chunks). Like (2) through (6) it is new policy text: the committed scores were computed against a corpus without SJRTD and say nothing about the new SJRTD cases, none of which has ever been scored live — its fifteen cases were renumbered on merge (ground-055..058, edge-087..093, fresh-024, ml-034, refuse-032, xagency-016, the FAX precedent). (8) 2026-08-14: AC Transit added as the twelfth agency, three documents (actransit-fares, actransit-fares-es, actransit-discounts), rebinding corpus_version once more to 5db0d6a4bfbd (33 documents, 214 chunks), which is what HEAD now ships. Like the others it is new policy text: the committed scores were computed against a corpus without AC Transit and say nothing about the new actransit-* cases, none of which has ever been scored live; the same PR retargets refuse-021 at Golden Empire Transit, since its old premise (AC Transit outside the corpus) no longer holds. Regenerate all three artifacts at the next promoted live eval run and remove these entries.

2026-08-13: prompts/system.txt moved v10 -> v11. The scope sentence named five agencies and instructed the model to decline "an agency, place, or service outside the five agencies above", while the corpus had grown to nine. Every gate was green throughout, because nothing compared the prompt to the manifest. The consequence is quiet: a rider asks about a corpus agency, retrieval finds the passages, and the model declines anyway. v11 names all nine and replaces the count with "the agencies listed above" so the sentence cannot go stale again; tests/test_prompt_agencies.py now fails the build if the manifest and the prompt disagree, or if a count is reintroduced. The committed scores were produced under v10 and therefore under the narrower scope rule. They remain valid for the five agencies v10 covered and say nothing about how the model behaves toward E-tran, SCMTD, SolTrans or FAX, which v10 told it to refuse. 2026-08-13/14: v11 -> v12 adds County Connection (CCCTA) as the tenth named agency, in the same PR that adds its corpus documents, because tests/test_prompt_agencies.py now fails a corpus agency the prompt does not name. v12 is marked NOT YET LIVE-VALIDATED in its header; the committed scores were produced under v10 and say nothing about CCCTA behavior. 2026-08-14: v12 -> v13 adds San Joaquin RTD (SJRTD) as the eleventh named agency on the same terms; v13 is marked NOT YET LIVE-VALIDATED in its header, and the committed scores say nothing about SJRTD behavior. 2026-08-14: v13 -> v14 adds AC Transit as the twelfth named agency on the same terms; v14 is marked NOT YET LIVE-VALIDATED in its header, and the committed scores say nothing about AC Transit behavior. Regenerate at the next promoted live eval run and remove these entries.
